Her words on the Abortion Funding Awareness Act concern Medicaid payment reporting and funding transparency, not gestational limits or exceptions; no bill number is given.

rows.reasoning: Every surviving passage is adjacent: H.R. 26 (Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act) governs care for infants born alive, H.R. 7 (118th) and the Abortion Funding Awareness Act concern funding, and none states when abortion is legal or which exceptions (rape, incest, the mother's life or health) apply. Her words ('I will always defend life and support mothers and their children') name no limit or exception rule, so no rung from 'keep abortion legal at every stage' to 'ban abortion in all cases, with no exceptions' is evidenced.
